candidates: When updating or adding GitHub links that point to Storybook monorepo source files, verify that the entire URL resolves on the target branch — not just the branch segment. A mechanical `main` → `next` substitution is insufficient if the file paths themselves are stale. In the Storybook monorepo, the v7+ restructuring moved framework code from `app/<framework>/src/` to `code/frameworks/<framework>/src/` and renderer code to `code/renderers/<renderer>/src/`; links that still reference the old `app/` layout will 404 regardless of branch.

When a GitHub link to a monorepo source file includes a line-range anchor (e.g., `#L255-L275`), independently verify that those line numbers are accurate on the target branch. Line numbers shift as code evolves, so a correctly-pathed link can still silently point to unrelated code if the anchor is not updated.
